name: Vegetable Soup
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 slice of bread, toasted and buttered

steps: Boil the onion, turnip, potatoes, carrot, and celery in the water until the vegetables are cooked.
Insert the bread into a bowl. Pour the soup over it.

culture.text: Vegetable soup is a common soup prepared using vegetables as primary ingredients. It dates to ancient history, and in modern times is also a mass-produced food product.
